alignments.note: Waw of the consecutive form; ASV writes the connective *Then* for it (rule 14), the verb taking the verb.

Finite verb with its subject pronoun (rule 17) and the phrasal particle *in*, which names nothing on its own and stays with the verb (rule 44). Competing reading: *in* could be read as part of the rendering of the adverb פְּנִימָה, but that adverb has its own written word *within* below.
The adverb פְּנִימָה takes the *within* the ASV writes for it; the italic *the palace* beside it is a noun the Hebrew never wrote and is aligned separately.
Ordinary preposition (rule 11).
Proper name.
Article on מֶלֶךְ takes the written *the* (rule 15).
Noun in apposition to the name.

ASV supplies both the determiner and the head noun *the palace*, italicized; the Hebrew writes only the adverb פְּנִימָה, so no morpheme licenses the noun (rule 33's supplied-head-noun case, rule 30). Competing reading: give *within the palace* whole to פְּנִימָה under rule 31, rejected because that rule expands a substantive's lexeme and here the lexeme is already fully written by *within*. The ASV italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
Waw of the consecutive form → *and* (rule 14).
Finite verb; the ASV writes no separate subject pronoun for it.
Verb with its subject pronoun and auxiliary; head on the lexical verb (rules 17, 24).
Object marker H853; the ASV writes the object bare, so the marker has no English of its own (rule 16).
כֹּל → *all*; the construct's relation is carried by the following nouns (rule 19).
No article morpheme stands in this chain, so the ASV's *the* is supplied and joins the construct noun's unit (rules 15, 29); head on the lexeme.
Nomen rectum carries the relational *of* (rule 19), headed on the name (rule 24).

No conjunction morpheme stands before אֶת־מִזְבַּח — the Hebrew juxtaposes the objects — so the coordinating *and* the ASV supplies answers to no morpheme (rule 14's closing sentences, rule 30). It is not folded into the object marker or the noun beside it, for the reason rule 42 gives about a surplus *and*. The clause's later waws (s019, s024, s029) each hold a connective of their own.
Article on the nomen rectum עוֹלָה, which the ASV renders anarthrously; the article takes the phrase's single *the*, fronted to the left edge (rule 29).
Construct noun keeps only its own word; the *the* is the rectum's article under rule 29.
Object marker with no English of its own (rule 16).
Rectum takes the relational *of* (rule 19); head on *burnt*, which carries the lexeme, since *offering* alone is any offering (rule 31).
Waw rendered by the connective *with*, exactly as the town-list waw of וְחַצְרֵיהֶן → *with their villages* (rule 14).
Object marker with no English of its own (rule 16).
כֹּל → *all* (rule 19: the construct noun takes only its own word).
No article morpheme is present, so the ASV's *the* is supplied and belongs to the nominal expression (rule 15); head on the lexeme.
Pronominal suffix → *thereof* (rule 18).
Waw → *and* (rule 14).
Object marker with no English of its own (rule 16).
Article on the nomen rectum מַעֲרֶכֶת, which the ASV renders anarthrously as *showbread*; the article takes the fronted *the* (rule 29).
Construct noun keeps only its own word (rule 29).
Rectum takes the relational *of* (rule 19), headed on the noun realizing the lexeme.
Waw rendered *with*, as at s019 (rule 14).
Object marker with no English of its own (rule 16).
כֹּל → *all* (rule 19).
Supplied *the* joins the nominal expression, no article morpheme being present (rule 15).

review_notes: Two waw-for-*with* renderings (s019, s029) follow rule 14's open connective list; the earlier *and* at t022 stands before an asyndetic אֵת phrase with no conjunction morpheme, so it is `added`.

The italic *the palace* (t010–t011) is aligned `added` because the Hebrew writes only the adverb פְּנִימָה, whose *within* is separately aligned; the alternative of folding the whole phrase into that adverb under rule 31 is named in the unit's note.

Both articles in the verse (s017, s027) sit on anarthrously-rendered recta and take the fronted *the* under rule 29; the four *the*s before *house* and *vessels* are supplied, no article morpheme standing in those chains.
